title: Rust SimRadio TCP client for Medium simulator
description:
Add a SimRadio implementation to lichen-hal that connects to the Medium simulator over TCP, enabling Rust nodes in mixed simulations with Python and Zephyr.

Implementation:
- New file: rust/lichen-hal/src/sim_radio.rs
- Implement Radio trait with TCP backend
- Wire protocol: MSG_TX, MSG_RX_ENTER, MSG_RX_EXIT, MSG_REGISTER
- Feature-gated behind std (uses TcpStream)

Wire protocol (length-prefixed, 4-byte LE):
- REGISTER (0x01): node_id + position
- TX (0x10): channel + power + payload -> TX_DONE
- RX_ENTER (0x24): channel + timeout -> RX_PACKET or RX_TIMEOUT
- RX_EXIT (0x26): exit RX mode

Test: cargo test with a mock TCP server or against running Medium instance.
